workload: Same red/440Hz fMP4, sequential 512-byte chunks with an 8ms delivery tick per chunk, while main thread runs45ms work every60ms. This ensures append overlap with UI stress; first unpaced run completed appends before stress began and cannot answer contention hypothesis.
sampling: 11 paired trials, alternating order, fresh page and owner each trial, shared browser; no timed warmup discarded
primary_metric: wall milliseconds from owner construction through all append updateend completions
acceptance: All output controls pass; paired median append-time improvement must be positive and paired bootstrap 95 percent interval must exclude zero. Otherwise inconclusive for this workload. No global product admission threshold. Each trial must execute at least three stress callbacks before append completion.
costs: Includes worker startup, handle transfer, input transfer/copy, all append completion. Cleanup separately timed. UI stress identical; retained input length recorded. No CPU, hardware, physical energy or production speed claim. Concurrent host load is uncontrolled.
